title: Lists in Templates: Liquid Filters for Containers and Their Items | Orchard Core
description:
A template that shows a blog needs the posts of the blog, their number, and, on a post, the blog that holds it. A list stores these relationships in the content items themselves, and a template has to read them back.

The Lists module gives Liquid templates three filters for this: container returns the list that holds an item, and list_items and list_count read the published items of a list. The ListPart shape renders one page of a list, and the Orchard helper offers the same queries in Razor.

In this video:
• How a list is stored: ContainedPart and three filters
• The ListPart template: rendering the items of a list
• The container filter: from an item to its list
• Items and counts: list_items and list_count
• A template that uses all three on a blog post page
• The same queries in a Razor view
